title: Blue Travel Brand Application Tiles
whatItIs: A lavender board of rounded tiles: glass feature cards over a photo, a roadside billboard with an app phone, a store-listing card, a home-screen icon, blue and white bottles, and a business card held in a hand.
whatItMeans: Repeating one strong blue across billboard, bottles and cards builds instant recognition and a sense of scale.
techniques: Mix of environment scenes and flat product shots
Same logo mark on merchandise and app icon
Hand-held business card for a human touch

A design shown inside a realistic location.
A blurred translucent card over an image.
